description: Fix 6 issues identified in semantic review: (1) client-side MDX defeats SSG, (2) doubled anchor elements, (3) ghost articles in sidebar, (4) TOC timing, (5) CopyButton scoping, (6) hydration mismatch in DocsSearch.
steps: Move MDX import to server level in page.tsx, simplify MDXContent.tsx
Remove rehype-autolink-headings from next.config.mjs since custom HeadingLink handles anchors
Add published flag to DOC_SECTIONS and filter unpublished from sidebar/search
Add MutationObserver to DocsTableOfContents to re-scan headings when content changes
Fix CopyButton to use a ref scoped to its parent pre element
Fix hydration mismatch in DocsSearch by deferring isMac detection to useEffect
acceptance_criteria: MDX content renders server-side (no client-side import())
No doubled anchor elements on headings
Only published articles appear in sidebar and search
TOC correctly populates headings after content loads
CopyButton copies the correct code block
No hydration mismatch on platform detection
verification: Run typecheck: export NVM_DIR='/root/.nvm' && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/nucrm-bigplan-by-vm-enterprise-v2 && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty
